records.text: Owens said sources with direct knowledge told her the unused SUVs did not go to the hospital, and said three security vehicles were left behind.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It is a wonder to me because I learned from some sources with direct knowledge that they did not take these cars to the hospital. ... You have three security vehicles that are all of them actually are left behind. You have the keys.
